unknown_name: You again? Did you run out of crystals already?

options.text: No I just wanted to talk to you.

unknown_name_yes_1: Hmph.{p=0.3} How about you learn some manners and at least ask my name before you come begging for more crystals.

unknown_name_no_1: I mean- yeah sure. I guess I can talk for a bit. My name's Seri.{var(Seri_Name_Known) true}
default: Back again? You're lucky I don't need these crystals for something.
